purpose: Build a strictly causal, prefix-invariant, multi-scale path grammar and test whether nested pullbacks, reacceleration, consolidation breakouts, retests, false-breakout reentry, and exhaustion distinguish positive continuous action value from same-date risk-matched failures.

causal_scale.price: adjusted log close on valid observed bars
causal_scale.past_volatility: root mean square of the previous 20 completed close-to-close log returns, excluding the current return
causal_scale.threshold_rule: max(round_trip_cost_log_return, multiplier * max(round_trip_cost_log_return, past_volatility)) locked whenever the provisional extreme is updated

chan_candidate_grammar.role: explicit candidate representation whose empirical value must be tested
chan_candidate_grammar.inclusion_merge: causal high-low containment merge; rising context keeps the larger high and larger low, falling context keeps the smaller high and smaller low
chan_candidate_grammar.provisional_fractal: middle of the latest three inclusion-normalized bars; may change and is always tagged provisional
chan_candidate_grammar.confirmed_fractal: the same three-bar relation is confirmed only when a fourth non-inclusive normalized bar starts and locks the right neighbor
chan_candidate_grammar.fractal_shape: top requires both middle high and low above both neighbors; bottom requires both below
chan_candidate_grammar.stroke: immutable connection of alternating confirmed fractals separated by at least three normalized bars and with direction-consistent endpoint prices
chan_candidate_grammar.segment: candidate direction confirmed by three completed alternating strokes whose second same-direction endpoint extends the first
chan_candidate_grammar.center: nonempty intersection of the price intervals of the latest three completed strokes
chan_candidate_grammar.breakout: close crosses the latest confirmed center boundary plus the causal cost buffer
chan_candidate_grammar.retest_hold: after breakout, the observed bar touches the broken boundary but closes on the breakout side
chan_candidate_grammar.reentry: after breakout, the observed close returns through the broken boundary; this is a known state change, not a forecast label
chan_candidate_grammar.exhaustion: a new same-direction structural extreme with both normalized slope and mean log-amount below the previous completed stroke of that direction

candidate_patterns.nested_up_pullback: large and medium directional states are up while the small state is down
candidate_patterns.nested_up_reacceleration: a small-scale trough confirms while medium and large states remain up
candidate_patterns.nested_down_rebound: large and medium directional states are down while the small state is up
candidate_patterns.nested_down_reacceleration: a small-scale peak confirms while medium and large states remain down
candidate_patterns.zone_retest_hold_up: causal upward breakout boundary retest that closes above the boundary
candidate_patterns.zone_reentry_after_up_breakout: causal close back through an earlier upward breakout boundary
candidate_patterns.up_exhaustion: medium- or large-scale new high satisfies the relational exhaustion definition
candidate_patterns.up_breakout_confirmed_participation: zone_breakout_up with five-day price-amount correlation rank at or above 0.5 and last-30-minute return rank below 0.5
candidate_patterns.up_breakout_late_chase: zone_breakout_up with last-30-minute return rank at or above 0.5

evaluation.scope: existing top-20-percent causal activity-gate OOS prediction rows
evaluation.risk_match: same trade date and inherited five-coordinate risk_match_cell_code
evaluation.matched_control: rows in the same date-risk cell where the candidate pattern is absent
evaluation.matched_failure: negative-action-value row in the same date-risk cell where the candidate pattern is present
evaluation.date_weighting: equal weight across dates after equal weighting of eligible risk cells within date
evaluation.uncertainty: Newey-West HAC with lag 20 on daily quantities
evaluation.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg within cost scenario across candidate-pattern matched action-value contrasts
evaluation.promotion_gate: at least the minimum candidate and matched dates, positive absolute action value with positive HAC lower bound, positive matched-value HAC lower bound with BH q at most 0.05, majority positive years across all 13 diagnostic years, and compatible downside under both costs
evaluation.account_replay_gate: prohibited unless at least one predeclared candidate passes the promotion gate
